notes.title: v1.7 Streamers and Casters Update
notes.notes:
Bloodstream has implemented a raft of updates for Streamers and Casters!
[list]
[*] Record your avatar fighting using the new 3rd person Observer Camera. 
[*] Publish a video of yourself embedded in the virtual world with a webcam, greenscreen and LIV! 
[*] The new Combo system tracks your coolest moves. 
[/list]

Note that you will need to record and publish the video yourself using software like OBS Studio. 

This update also contains a major rework to the stream system with more organic stream shapes, movements and sounds.

Other improvements:
[list]
[*] Player can eject stream/powerup by pressing thumbstick/trackpad
[*] Pause by pointing at ingame menu and pressing thumbstick/trackpad
[*] Score is displayed
[*] Enemies no longer run behind you
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
